Find Differences with respect to AI Table

find_differences_wrt_AI.Rd

Find the differences between AI grading and experts and return all graded assignments that are different and a matrix of which rubrics are mismatched.

Usage

find_differences_wrt_AI(experts_file, ai_file)

Arguments

experts_file

file with expert graders

ai_file

file with AI graders

Value

a list of a df and a matrix
